verdict.summary: Email annonce@jp.dk CONFIRMED as a mailto: link on the publisher's official ad-sales site jpannonce.dk (contact page). All 20 titles assessed alive. Flagship JP/Politikens Hus titles (Politiken, Morgenavisen Jyllands-Posten, Ekstra Bladet, Finans) all have live sites with 2026 content. The full Watch Medier portfolio is confirmed via the watchmedier.dk brands page, with fresh dated articles (June-Aug 2026) on AgriWatch, FinansWatch, ShippingWatch, ITWatch, MediaWatch, KapWatch, PolicyWatch, EnergyWatch. Three nuances: (1) EnergyWatch.dk now redirects to the international energywatch.com; the Danish edition appears as energiwatch.dk on the brands page. (2) CleantechWatch redirects from cleantechwatch.dk to the shorter ctwatch.dk but the brand title is unchanged. (3) KapWatch's domain (kapwatch.dk) is live but its on-page brand/title displays as 'KapitalWatch'. BygTek (bygtek.dk), Jyllands-Posten Erhverv (jyllands-posten.dk/erhverv), and Politiken Magasinet (politiken.dk/magasinet) are all live sections. Note: WebFetch masks/blocks watchmedier.dk, so brand verification was done via raw curl of the brands page.
